app_shell.purpose: Deployment-scoped admin console for execution logging search, trace inspection, analytics, and configuration.
global_dependencies: Authenticated session managed outside this contract
Active deployment context for deployment-scoped routes except global logging coverage

shared_states.unauthenticated: Show sign-in/reauth required state when API returns 401.
shared_states.forbidden: Show access denied messaging when API returns 403, noting execution log access is restricted to privileged users.
shared_states.unknown_error: Show retry option and capture correlation/debug info where available.

pages.title: Execution Request Search
pages.purpose: Find request-level execution logs using supported request filters, then drill into full execution traces.
data_requirements: deployment_id from route
Search form fields: date_range.start, date_range.end, optional status_in[], optional final_outcome_in[], optional policy_id, optional definition_version, optional search_attributes object, page.limit
Search results: request_id, policy metadata, timestamps, status, final_outcome, outcome_reason_codes, search_attributes, metrics

api_consumption.usage: Primary search request for request-level logs.

user_actions: Adjust result limit up to supported max
Open a result in Execution Trace Detail
Open a result in lightweight Request Summary Detail
loading_states: Initial empty state before first search
Inline submitting state on search form
Results table skeleton while awaiting response

error_states.ui_handling: Show field-level validation for invalid date range, malformed payload, or excessive limit.
Show retry banner and preserve entered filters.

pages.empty_state: No matching requests found for the selected filters.
notes: The UI must communicate that search_attributes supports curated exact-match filters only; arbitrary JSON-wide free text search is not exposed by the API contract.

pages.title: Execution Step Search
pages.purpose: Search rule/stage execution steps by rule metadata, step status, and observed variable content, then navigate to parent request traces.
data_requirements: deployment_id from route
Search form fields: date_range, optional stage_type, optional step_status, optional rule_name, optional policy_id, optional variable_match{name,value,matched}, page.limit
Results: request_id, step_sequence, stage_type, rule, policy, execution_timestamp, step_status, condition_expression, variable_observations, decision, performance, errors
user_actions: Search by variable name and optional value/matched flag
Open parent request trace from a step result

error_states.ui_handling: Show validation including required variable_match.name when variable_match is supplied.
Show retry banner and preserve filters.

notes: Search is limited to the fields in the authoritative API: date, stage, status, rule_name, policy_id, and variable_match. The frontend must not imply arbitrary full-text search across all step JSON.

pages.title: Execution Trace Detail
pages.purpose: Provide the canonical deep-dive view of a request, combining request-level metadata/payloads with all ordered execution steps.
data_requirements: deployment_id and request_id from route
Optional id_type hint (request_id|correlation_id|auto) from query or lookup control
Trace data including request-level record and execution_steps[]

api_consumption.usage: Primary data source for the full trace page.

user_actions: Toggle between request metadata, request payload, response payload, and steps tabs/sections
Switch id_type hint if lookup may represent a correlation ID
Navigate to adjacent focused detail pages if desired
loading_states: Page skeleton for summary panels and steps list
Per-step expansion loading is local only because all steps are returned in one response

error_states.ui_handling: Show not found state with option to return to search.

pages.empty_state: Not applicable; a successful trace response may contain zero steps only if backend returns it that way, but typical trace view should render request details regardless.
notes: This is the preferred drilldown destination from all search screens.
No API exists for annotations, exports, or sharing links beyond route deep-linking.

pages.title: Execution Request Summary Detail
pages.purpose: Display request-level execution information without loading step-level trace data when a lighter view is preferred.
data_requirements: deployment_id and request_id from route
Optional id_type query hint
Request-level execution record

api_consumption.usage: Fetch request-level summary, payloads, retention, and ingestion metadata.

pages.title: Execution Steps Detail
pages.purpose: Show the ordered list of execution steps for a request when the user only needs the step timeline.
data_requirements: deployment_id and request_id from route
Ordered steps for the request

error_states.ui_handling: Show not found/no recorded steps state.

pages.empty_state: No recorded steps found for this request.

pages.title: Request Impact Search
pages.purpose: Identify requests affected by a rule/version or decision pattern and inspect matched steps per request.
data_requirements: deployment_id from route
Search form: date_range, optional rule_name, optional rule_version, optional decision_outcome, optional reason_code, page.limit
Results: deployment_id, request_id, first_execution_timestamp, matched_steps[]
user_actions: Expand matched steps under a request

error_states.ui_handling: Show invalid date range or malformed request validation.

pages.empty_state: No impacted requests found for the selected criteria.
notes: This page supports impact-style discovery, but it does not itself compare versions numerically; that belongs to the policy version comparison analytics endpoint.

pages.title: Outcome Trends Analytics
pages.purpose: Show outcome and approval-rate trends over time with optional version or segment slicing.
data_requirements: deployment_id from route
Form: date_range, period_unit, optional policy_id, optional definition_version, optional segment_attribute
Results by period with counts, approval_rate, outcomes[], optional definition_version, optional segment
user_actions: Optionally segment by one curated search attribute

error_states.ui_handling: Show validation for invalid date range, unsupported period unit, or unsupported segment attribute.
Show retry action while preserving filters.

pages.empty_state: No trend data available for the selected range/filters.
notes: segment_attribute must map to a curated search_attributes key; the UI should present a controlled selector, not free text.

pages.title: Policy Version Comparison Analytics
pages.purpose: Compare exactly two definition versions of a policy on business outcomes and processing metrics.
data_requirements: deployment_id from route
Form: date_range, policy_id, exactly two definition_versions
Results per definition version with request volume, approval metrics, avg_duration_ms, avg_rule_execution_count, total_errors, outcome_breakdown
user_actions: Review side-by-side metrics and outcome breakdown

error_states.ui_handling: Show validation that policy_id is required and exactly two definition versions must be supplied.

pages.empty_state: No comparison data found for the selected policy versions/date range.
notes: The API does not provide a list of available policies or versions, so unless such data is supplied elsewhere in the app, these inputs must be free-form or populated from prior known context/search results.

pages.title: Segment Outcome Analytics
pages.purpose: Analyze outcome rates by a selected curated segment attribute.
data_requirements: deployment_id from route
Form: date_range, required segment_attribute, optional policy_id, optional definition_version
Results by segment with total_requests, approved_count, rejected_count, approval_rate, outcomes[]

error_states.ui_handling: Show validation that segment_attribute is required and must be curated/supported.

pages.empty_state: No segmented outcome data available for the selected filters.
notes: The frontend should not imply arbitrary segmentation on any payload field; only curated search_attributes-backed segment keys are supported.

pages.title: Rule Performance Analytics
pages.purpose: Analyze execution count, latency, failures, warnings, and lookup intensity by rule/stage.
data_requirements: deployment_id from route
Form: date_range, optional policy_id, optional definition_version
Results with rule_name, rule_version, stage_type, execution_count, failed_count, warning_count, failure_rate, avg_duration_ms, max_duration_ms, total_lookup_count, error_instances
user_actions: Sort by failure rate, duration, warnings, or lookup count
Use a rule name from results to navigate to Step Search with prefilled rule_name (frontend-only routing behavior)
pages.empty_state: No rule performance data available for the selected filters.
notes: The API does not provide a dedicated drilldown endpoint from a performance aggregate row; the UI may only route the user into step search prefilled with the rule name.

pages.title: Deployment Configuration
pages.purpose: Inspect and update deployment-level logging, retention, hosting, and access-control settings.
data_requirements: deployment_id from route
Config record fields from GET and PUT responses
user_actions: Edit deployment name, environment, hosting model
Set default retention days and purge mode
Edit access-control fields allowed_user_ids and admin_only
loading_states: Initial form skeleton while loading config
Saving spinner with form disabled during PUT

error_states.ui_handling: Show field validation for malformed payload or invalid enum values.
Show insufficient privileges to modify config.
Show retry/save failed banner and preserve unsaved edits.

pages.empty_state: If no config exists but PUT is allowed, present a create configuration form seeded from deployment_id.
notes: PUT is replace semantics; frontend should submit the full configuration object, not partial patches.
No API exists to test access-control users or purge logs from this screen.

pages.title: Global Logging Coverage Analytics
pages.purpose: Provide cross-deployment operational visibility into logged versus non-logged request coverage.
data_requirements: Form: date_range
Results: deployment_id, logging_enabled, request_count, deployment_name, environment, hosting_model, default_logging_enabled
user_actions: Group/sort results by deployment, environment, hosting model, or logging_enabled
Navigate to a deployment configuration page from a deployment row

error_states.ui_handling: Show access denied state for cross-deployment analytics.

pages.empty_state: No logging coverage data available for the selected date range.
notes: This endpoint is cross-deployment and cannot itself drill into individual request lists; any deeper investigation must start from a chosen deployment and separate search screens.

constraints_and_gaps.gap: No endpoint exists to enumerate deployments, policies, definition versions, supported segment attributes, or supported curated search_attributes keys.
constraints_and_gaps.frontend_implication: The frontend must rely on route context, app-provided metadata outside this API contract, or free-form inputs with helper text. It must not assume discoverability endpoints exist.

constraints_and_gaps.gap: No endpoint exists for arbitrary full-text search across request/response JSON blobs.
constraints_and_gaps.frontend_implication: Search UI must be limited to the contract’s supported filters: curated search_attributes for request search and variable_match for step search.

constraints_and_gaps.gap: No endpoint exists for delete/purge operations on logs.
constraints_and_gaps.frontend_implication: Deployment configuration may display retention/purge mode but cannot offer direct purge execution controls.

constraints_and_gaps.gap: No endpoint exists for AI/LLM insight generation or natural-language querying.
constraints_and_gaps.frontend_implication: Do not design chat, recommendations, or AI insight screens as active functionality in this POV.

constraints_and_gaps.gap: No write endpoint exists for creating execution request/step log records.
constraints_and_gaps.frontend_implication: Frontend is read/analytics/config focused only; ingestion management is out of scope for this contract.
